cooldown_days.description: Minimum days between two nudges of the SAME machine. Restores (steps back toward the proto default while a machine works) are not cooldown-gated.

enabled.description: Master switch for QoS Priority Actuator. Ships OFF: install it, look around, then turn it on when you want daily starved-machine priority nudges to start.

log_actions.description: Write one log line per scheduled action (machine, cause, priority change, prediction), plus a per-pass summary.

max_actions_per_day.description: Cap on priority actions (nudges + restores together) scheduled per in-game day across all machines.

max_nudge_steps.description: How far below its proto default a machine's priority may be stepped (the band). At 2, a default-9 machine can be stepped to 8, then 7 — never further, and never below 0. Values you set outside this band are treated as yours and are never adjusted or restored.

nudge_starved.description: Step up the priority of machines observed input-starved (NotEnoughInput) for 'persistence_days' consecutive days.

persistence_days.description: A machine must be observed input-starved on this many consecutive daily passes before its first nudge. Transient starvation is ignored.

restore_when_working.description: While a machine is Working, step its priority back toward its proto default (one step per day) — but only if the current value is exactly one this mod's own rule could have set. Values you set are never 'restored'.
